title: Broken for Fruitfulness
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Broken for Fruitfulness | Good Soil, Holiness, Spiritual Fruit, and Justifying Grace - Luke v8:15

God breaks up the hard places in us so His Word can take root and bear lasting fruit. In Luke v8:15, the good ground is an honest and good heart that hears the Word, keeps it, and brings forth fruit with patience. What feels like plowing, pruning, and discipline is often the mercy of God preparing us to live for Him.

Hebrews v12:9-11 reminds us that the Father's correction is for our profit, that we might share in His holiness. Though discipline is not pleasant in the moment, it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness. Through Romans v5:1-2, we rest in the gospel itself: justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, and by grace we stand in hope. The heart Christ can use is the heart surrendered, softened, and made fruitful by Him.
